notes.title: Patch 1.12 is now live
notes.content:
It includes the following:

Changes:
* Subtitles added to the English cinematics.

Bug fixes:
* Script error related to the irrbloss.
* Problems interacting with the hags foot.
* Incorrect interactions with the shadowy being.
* Errors related to the chain puzzle.

Please let us know on the Steam Oknytt forums if you have any problems with this patch. Finally, thanks to everyone who reported bugs and made this patch possible.
